articles.title: California's Governor Race Is So Close We Still Don't Know Who Won!
articles.summary: Imagine a race with 60 people! California's primary for governor is too close to call. Democrat Xavier Becerra and Republican Steve Hilton are leading, but votes are still being counted. The top two will face off in November.

articles.title: Trump Called Netanyahu 'Crazy'—But Says They're Still Friends
articles.summary: President Trump admitted he called Israel's leader 'crazy' during a phone call. He was upset because fighting in Lebanon is making peace talks with Iran harder. But both leaders say they still work well together.

articles.title: Brazil's President Says 'No Way!' to New U.S. Tariffs
articles.summary: Brazil's leader Lula is upset about new U.S. tariffs—a 25% tax on some Brazilian goods. He thought relations were getting better after a White House meeting, but now says Brazil won't accept this treatment.
